test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Services e-Health Assistance and Teleconsultation (SeHAT) is a teleconsultation service launched by which of the following ministries ?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Defence.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Defence**

 
 
• The defence of India and all of its parts is the responsibility of the** Indian government**. The **President** holds the Armed Forces Supreme Command. The **Cabinet** is in charge of ensuring the nation's defence.
 
• This is carried out by the Ministry of Defence, which gives the** Armed Forces** the policy framework and tools they need to carry out their duties as part of the country's defence. The Ministry of Defence is headed by the **Raksha Mantri** or Defense Minister.
 
• The Defense Ministry's primary responsibility is to obtain policy directives from the government on **all matters pertaining to defence and security and to communicate **them to the Services Headquarters, Inter-Services Organizations, Production Establishments, and Research and Development Organizations for implementation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of AYUSH**

 
 
• **​**On **November 9, 2014**, the Ministry of Ayush was established with the intention of bringing back the profound knowledge of our ancient medical systems and ensuring the best possible growth and spread of the Ayush medical systems.
 
• In the past, these systems were developed by the Department of **Indian System of Medicine and Homoeopathy (ISM&H)**, which was** established in 1995.**
 
• In **November 2003**, it was renamed the **Department of Ayurveda, Yoga, and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy (Ayush)**, with a focus on Ayurveda, Yoga, and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy education and research.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs**
 
 
• **​**A ministry of the Indian government is known as the Ministry of Home Affairs, or simply the** Home Ministry**. It is primarily accountable for maintaining domestic policy and internal security as India's interior ministry.
 
• **Amit Shah**, Union Minister of Home Affairs, is in charge of the Home Ministry.
 
• The cadre controlling authority for the** Indian Police Service (IPS), DANIPS, and DANICS** is also the Home Ministry. The ministry's Police-I Division is in charge of cadre control for the Indian Police Service; DANIPS' administrative division, on the other hand, is the UT Division.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development**
 
 
• **​**With effect from **January 30, 2006**, the Department of Women and Child Development of the Government of India became a separate Ministry. Prior to that, it had been a Department within the **Ministry of Human Resources Development since 1985.**
 
• The primary objective of the Ministry was** to fill in the gaps in state action for women and children by encouraging **interministerial and sectoral convergence in the development of gender-equitable and child-centred legislation, policies, and programs.
